about: The final merch set for print: the RiskMandate T-shirts, hoodies and business cards of the seven going to Web Summit 2026, proposed by designer@web-summit.dinis on 2 November 2026 for Dinis to sign off item by item. RiskMandate only (Dinis, 2 November 2026): no sponsor, no other brand, no Web Summit name or logo on anything printed. The print files are made from this file and data/design.json by team/designer/print/make-print.py and published at /print/ for the printers. Sign-off: set signed_off to {"by": "dinis", "at": "<ISO time>"} on each item (Dinis, or his agent on his word).
rules: RiskMandate only: no sponsor logo, no other brand, no Web Summit name or logo, on any garment or card (Dinis, 2 November 2026).
Every back and every card carries the wearer's own QR code, to https://web-summit.sgit.ai/meet/<id>/, black on a white panel with its quiet zone.

tee.blank: TH Clothes Ankara, 190 g, 100% cotton, or an equivalent (the printer's suggestion is welcome)
tee.method: DTF or DTG, full colour (seven small runs, so no screen printing)

chest.where: left chest (wearer's left), top 180 mm below the shoulder seam

card.stock: 350 g/m2 or heavier, matt, both sides printed, square corners

people.note: T6 said 'to Web Summit': taken out, as nothing but RiskMandate goes on the merch.

sizes: Each person's sizes (3 T-shirts and a hoodie) are still to collect: Vicky and Silvio, from the seven, before the order (WS-48).
